note: Modern campground at Merritt Reservoir SRA on the point between two arms of the lake, with the park's shower building, a boat ramp and a fish-cleaning station. Sites sit on a low bluff above the lake. Beed's Landing campground (26 more reservable sites) is ~500 m south on its own spur. The dump station is across from the Fisherman's Boat Ramp, southeast of the dam. Park entry permit required. --Claude
summary: ReserveAmerica park page and all 25 Cedar Bay site pages read: Electric Plus 50 A (no water or sewer), 40-85 ft, one pull-through; park shower building is here; open year round; 180-day window. Hookups, sites, facilities, season and booking written; fees left. PIN IS 4.4 km OFF (at the dam): re-pin. Lakeview confirmed. Willow Cove is a split candidate.
flags: PIN MOVE: stored 42.63058,-100.86481 is at the east end of the dam by the Merritt Trading Post buildings, 4.4 km NE of Cedar Bay (Google's park pin 42.62577,-100.86039 is in the same area). Suggested 42.59770,-100.89506, the centroid of RA's GIS points for all 25 Cedar Bay sites. Sites 011-038 are on the point and 001-010 line the entry road ~400 m south.

WATER (lakeview confirmed): RA tags 6 of 25 sites 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront' (024, 028, 032, 033, 036, 038), but no site photos are posted. Imagery shows a continuous juniper/cedar band on steep banks between every row and the water. 3DEP puts 036/038 at ~902.4 m and 024 at ~903 m, ~5 m above the ~897.6 m lake and ~15-30 m back. 032 at the north tip is ~2 m above. That fits the note's 'low bluff' and is a buffer, so not on-water.

SPLIT CANDIDATE, Willow Cove Campground: 9 reservable Electric Plus sites (50 A, 40-60 ft, back-in, RA-tagged 'Lakefront' along the shore), centroid 42.62142,-100.86577. It is ~2.9 km NE of Cedar Bay and ~1 km S of the dam on its own spur off the dam road. Not in the DB.

Beed's Landing Campground (24 Electric Plus 50 A + 2 Basic reservable, 35-88 ft, centroid 42.59329,-100.89326; Google 'Beed's Landing' 4.5 from 35 reviews): ~500 m from Cedar Bay with its own spur. It is under the ~1 km split line, so I mentioned it in the note rather than proposing an entry. RA tags its sites 017-022 'Lakefront'.
SAND RULE (question, not a drop as I read it): RA gives 'Driveway Surface: Sand' for 23 of 25 Cedar Bay sites (2 paved). These are numbered electric pads in a developed loop, not beach camping.
